summary: Measure canonical rolling GitHub merges and final ready-to-merged cycles with native objectives

rules.detail: Native objective rows evaluate distinct merged PR identities across all authors under an explicit effective-dated scope. Incomplete capture remains unknown, never successful. Final-ready latency is measured-only and requires proven complete lifecycle evidence.

compatibility.detail: The TypeScript DSL emits GitHub source, versioned scope, rolling throughput and measured-only latency declarations. Measurement uses canonical capture snapshots and reports source lag, correction revision and partial civil-day bars. The old queue-based merge-latency proxy declaration is retired.

manual.detail: No source, roster history, throughput target or latency policy is installed by default. Operators author the scope dates and throughput target explicitly; acquisition activation remains separately admitted.

recovery.detail: Measurement is derived from durable capture claims. Corrections and retractions replace prior samples; projection loss rebuilds without synthesizing successful windows.
